## General Contents

::: {.list-table}
- - Markdown files
  - Description
  - Reference

- - `welcome.md`
  - content for the welcome main tab
  - `app/ui/pages/welcome.py`

- - `announcements.md`
  - content for any short-term notices
  - `app/ui/components/announcements.py`

- - `tools.md`
  - location for externally available materials

- - `citing.md`

## Methods

The Methods interface is defined in `app/ui/pages/methods.py`. Its
accordion sections are configured in
`app/content/methods/methods-sections.yaml`.

::: {.list-table}
- - Files
  - Description

- - `methods-intro.md`
  - method introduction

- - `methods-sections.yaml`
  - yaml file that points to different markdown files for methods accordion listed below
:::
